title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 2ddf902d0e9c… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 2ddf902d0e9c4d8f28598df149c4ad3fee4d966b5c2b1e8eff5cb2677ddb3130 was observed twice in attacker activity on November 2, 2026. The attack involved the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer), indicating the file was used to transfer tools into a target environment. The file is associated with a malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. The attacker infrastructure was located in France. This indicator should be matched against files in environments and security feeds to detect potential compromise.
